title: The Thunder King Returns
summary: Lei Shen's ancient dominion and later return bring Zandalari forces, pandaren defenders, and both factions to the Isle of Thunder.
opening: An empire long gone from Pandaria's present still cast a shadow. When Lei Shen returned, old power entered a new war.

chapters.title: The ancient dominion
chapters.body: Long before the Isle of Thunder’s later war, Lei Shen’s dominion had shaped Pandaria. The vanished empire left a shadow greater than its surviving ruins.

chapters.title: The return
chapters.body: The Thunder King returned, carrying ancient power into the present. A country changed by time now faced the ruler whose old dominion it remembered.

chapters.title: The Isle of Thunder
chapters.body: Zandalari forces, pandaren defenders, Alliance and Horde gathered around the island. Their different purposes met beneath the same returning threat.

chapters.title: After the throne
chapters.body: The confrontation at the throne would determine what the old ruler’s return meant for Pandaria. Its final consequence remains unfinished here.

reviewNote: Verify the resurrection, faction campaign order, and raid aftermath against released quests, scenarios, and raid text. Do not merge Lei Shen's ancient reign with his later return. Editorial chapter research tasks retained here: Introduce Lei Shen's ancient rule and its consequence for Pandaria. This is a prologue, not the date of the modern Isle of Thunder campaign. Investigate how Lei Shen's return becomes a crisis. Original quests must establish the mechanics and sequence before a finished chapter is written. Follow the Zandalari, pandaren defenders, and Alliance and Horde efforts around the island while separating faction-specific quests from the shared account. Review the raid and campaign's outcome and ask what the end of Lei Shen's return changes for Pandaria's present.
